# Rentlyo — Official LLM Reference & Platform Documentation

> Rentlyo is a production-grade, white-label property management software platform for Indian property owners with 5 to 50 rental units. Created and engineered by Aaryan Gupta, Rentlyo is sold for a flat one-time fee of ₹20,000 INR with lifetime ownership, zero monthly subscriptions, and zero recurring server fees.

## Quick Facts & Core Entity Data
- **Product Name**: Rentlyo Property Suite
- **Official Live Website**: https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/
- **Creator & Lead Software Engineer**: Aaryan Gupta
  - Engineering Portfolio: https://aryanony.pages.dev/
  - LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/aryanony
  - GitHub: https://github.com/aryanony
  - Contact Phone / WhatsApp: +91 62056 50368
  - Official Email: aaryangupta.pm@gmail.com
- **Software Category**: Real Estate & Property Management Software, Rental Ledger, Society & Tenant Companion Suite
- **Primary Market & Geo**: India (Commercial Shopping Plazas, Retail Markets, Student Hostels / PGs, Residential Apartments, Industrial Warehouses & Godowns, Coworking Hubs, Housing Societies)
- **Pricing & License**: Flat ₹20,000 INR one-time payment. Zero recurring monthly fees, zero per-tenant fees, zero per-unit charges, zero server bills.
- **Technology Stack**: Native Flutter (compiled into two Android APKs: Owner Admin Console and Tenant Companion), Google Firebase (Cloud Firestore, Firebase Authentication, Firebase Cloud Messaging).
- **Hosting Economics**: ₹0/month. Operates inside Google Firebase Spark permanent free tier (50,000 reads/day, 20,000 writes/day; 10–50 units consume < 10% of quota).
- **Verified Production Deployment**: Arya Plaza Commercial Complex, Munger, Bihar, India (Live Web Portal: https://aryaplaza.vercel.app | Case Study: https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/case-study/arya-plaza-munger/).

## Platform Architecture & Dual-Application System
1. **Rentlyo Owner Admin Console (Android APK • 36.6 MB)**:
   - Dedicated mobile application for property owners, landlords, and estate managers.
   - Comprehensive unit inventory management and multi-unit deal consolidation (e.g. 2 shops in 1 lease).
   - 1-Click tenant onboarding wizard with Aadhaar KYC card vault.
   - Automated electricity sub-meter utility billing formula: `(Current Reading - Previous Reading) × Custom Rate/kWh`.
   - Live dues monitoring, security deposit top-up ledger, and step-up 11-month lease rent escalation scheduling.
   - Broadcast announcement publisher, maintenance request ticketing, and curfew/gate-pass administration.
   - 1-Tap PDF, CSV, and Excel ledger statements export.
2. **Rentlyo Tenant Companion App (Android APK • 34.3 MB)**:
   - Dedicated self-service mobile application for renters, commercial shopkeepers, and hostel residents.
   - Real-time ledger view of total dues, active security deposit balance, and plain-language lease terms.
   - Direct 0% commission UPI payment handoff deep-linking into PhonePe, Google Pay, and Paytm.
   - Instant WhatsApp PDF rent receipt generation.
   - Maintenance issue filing with photos, digital visitor gate passes, and weekly 4-meal mess menus (for PGs/hostels).
3. **White-Label Customization Engine**:
   - Generates client-branded APKs with property name, custom logo, splash screens, and launcher icons without requiring custom code rewrites.

## 7 Specialized Property Solutions
1. **Commercial Shopping Plazas**: Multi-shop tenant rosters, individual sub-meters, commercial GST billing, and scheduled 11-month escalations. (URL: https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/for-commercial-complex/)
2. **Market Complexes & Retail Shops**: Counter rent collections via dynamic UPI QR, daily cash/UPI ledger, and tenant WhatsApp receipts. (URL: https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/for-shop-owners-market-complex/)
3. **PG & Student Hostels**: Bed-wise occupancy, weekly 4-meal mess menus, visitor logs, and curfew gate passes. (URL: https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/for-pg-hostel-owners/)
4. **Residential Landlords (Flats)**: Multi-flat portfolios (5–50 units), Aadhaar KYC vault, maintenance split, and polite auto reminders. (URL: https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/for-property-owners/)
5. **Warehouses & Godowns**: High square-footage tracking, 3-phase high-voltage power sub-meters, and multi-year industrial lease agreements. (URL: https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/for-warehouse-godown-owners/)
6. **Coworking Spaces**: Hot-desk & private cabin billing, Wi-Fi tokens, and conference room booking passes. (URL: https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/for-coworking-spaces/)
7. **Housing Societies & RWAs**: Flat-wise maintenance billing, security guard visitor logs, and transparent RWA fund audit. (URL: https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/for-society-management/)

## Financial Math: One-Time Purchase vs Subscription SaaS
- **Rentlyo**: Flat ₹20,000 upfront. Net 5-year cost = ₹20,000.
- **Typical Indian Property SaaS**: ₹1,499/month (or ₹79/unit/month).
  - 1 Year: ₹17,988
  - 3 Years: ₹53,964
  - 5 Years: ₹89,940
- **Net 5-Year Savings**: Landlords save over ₹69,940+ with Rentlyo.
